label: Bootstrap stability ensemble of reduced-knot local correction
head_gap_caveat: Bootstrap-ensemble apparent training score mixes in-bag and out-of-bag predictions; its train/validation gap is not directly comparable with single-head in-sample gaps. Judge held-out metrics and member variability.
formula: 3 class-stratified bootstrap draws of6k correction; each fitsV19827-input2-knot head on fixedrawV178; pK=mean3 corrected probabilities; final=.75*pK+.25*spline77; save variance of member logits
rationale: V210 adds a tiny KS/AUC gain from10%V198, while V198 alone improves AUC but loses KS. Test retraining sensitivity of that specific representation through three intentional resamples, rather than declaring an OOF-only improvement. V187 used4k delete-block bagging on a different18-input representation and was negative.

label: Uncertainty-gated V193 and bootstrap correction blend
head_gap_caveat: Fixed-score fusion has no new trained head; inherits source models and resampling-proxy limitations.
formula: m=median of3-member logit variance on correction-training only; w=.1*m/(m+query_variance); p=(1-w)*pV193+w*pV219; ifm undefined/nearzero retainV193 explicitly; mean5foldtest
rationale: Test a bounded credibility gate that limits the lower-complexity representation where resampled corrections disagree. This is an epistemic proxy from3 conditional resamples, not a full posterior or a guarantee of safer risk estimates; no outer labels choose the gate.
